== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, light-grey shirt, forearm tattoo, denim shorts) and [[Tamás Papp]] (blue tee, white watch; same clothing as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals quiz 2.jpg]]). They are cutting cards at a recording table.

Setting up at the venue at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 2 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.
